name: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S26
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S26 is a standard Samsung Galaxy S26 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It combines increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic). The phone runs Android 16 / One UI 8.x or later.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S26, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T85°C Dc
atex.scope: Unit assessment: each unit is checked by a notified body. No certificate number is published.

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: Charge in safe area. Each unit spark-tested for intrinsically safe circuits (per Atexxo).

specs.display: 6.3-inch Dynamic LTPO AMOLED 2X; Gorilla Glass Victus 2 (front and back)
specs.chip: Exynos 2600 (UK/EU and most markets) / Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy (US, Canada, China, Japan)
specs.camera: 50 MP main + 12 MP ultra wide + 10 MP 3x telephoto
specs.batteryLife: Up to 30 hours of video playback
specs.satellite: Carrier-dependent (US: Verizon, T-Mobile; UK: Virgin Media O2)

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas

Dust group IIIB: not rated for conductive dust
Certified by ATEX unit assessment; no certificate number is published
